scope: Four public human-recorded read-speech Urdu clips, unchanged canonical host JNI greedy2threads, no hints. No phone/fluency/clinical acceptance. Heldouts were fixed before candidate inference and are held out only from these project comparisons.
comparability: Generic heldout2 runs were isolated from other model inference; earlier generic and fine-tuned runs have shared-host timing labels. Timing fields differ (native duration versus wall duration) and are not speedup claims.

quantity_observations.reference: چھے (six), attached to next word in dataset text

quantity_observations.generic_base: ستر (seventy), a word representation of the quantity
quantity_observations.result: Generic output retains the quantity semantically while the fine-tuned output does not; simple decimal-literal comparison alone is insufficient.
